deployments_detail.use: Honeywell Ensemble digital maintenance service uses an AI algorithm (EngineCompressorAI) to predict aircraft engine health/failures from near-real-time flight data (vibration, inter-turbine temperature, pressures, fuel burn) so operators can act before disruptions. Data flows via an aircraft data gateway into the Honeywell Forge analytics platform. [Honeywell Forge (EngineCompressorAI)]

deployments_detail.value: More than 2% fuel savings demonstrated, up to ~$8M annual savings (per Honeywell Flight Efficiency brochure)

[Honeywell (in-house)]
